title: is this the mall world?
content: my dream starts in a bowling alley, and im with my father hanging out. i forget exactly what happend after, but i remember going into a warp, and i was the anime character luffy. when the warp ended i was at a futuristic city with cars flying in the air, and it was a video game i was in. i was the character and i was luffy beating up everyone and going through each level
